    [B.1 — Namespace Setup]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  # Create namespace and enable Istio sidecar injection             │
    │  apiVersion: v1                                                    │
    │  kind: Namespace                                                   │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: anihpj                                                    │
    │    labels:                                                         │
    │      istio-injection: enabled    ← KEY: enables auto injection     │
    │      environment: production                                       │
    │  ---                                                               │
    │  # Verify after applying:                                          │
    │  kubectl get namespace anihpj --show-labels                        │
    │  # Expected:                                                       │
    │  # NAME      STATUS   LABELS                                       │
    │  # anihpj    Active   istio-injection=enabled,environment=prod     │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [B.2 — Dockerfile for anihpj/jobpost-api]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  # anihpj/jobpost/Dockerfile                                       │
    │                                                                    │
    │  FROM python:3.11-slim                                             │
    │                                                                    │
    │  # Set working directory                                           │
    │  WORKDIR /app                                                      │
    │                                                                    │
    │  # Install dependencies first (Docker layer cache optimization)   │
    │  COPY requirements.txt .                                           │
    │  RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt               │
    │                                                                    │
    │  # Copy application code                                          │
    │  COPY . .                                                          │
    │                                                                    │
    │  # Collect static files                                           │
    │  RUN python manage.py collectstatic --noinput                     │
    │                                                                    │
    │  # Health check endpoint (required for Kubernetes liveness probe) │
    │  HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --retries=3 \           │
    │    CMD curl -f http://localhost:8000/health/ || exit 1             │
    │                                                                    │
    │  # Run gunicorn (NOT Django dev server in production!)            │
    │  # Port 8000 — must match containerPort in Deployment            │
    │  EXPOSE 8000                                                       │
    │  CMD ["gunicorn", "--bind", "0.0.0.0:8000",                       │
    │       "--workers", "4", "--timeout", "120",                        │
    │       "anihpj.wsgi:application"]                                  │
    │                                                                    │
    │  # Build commands:                                                 │
    │  # docker build -t anihpj/jobpost-api:v1 .                        │
    │  # docker build -t anihpj/jobpost-api:v2 .  (for canary version)  │
    │  # docker push anihpj/jobpost-api:v1                              │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [anihpj DOCKER IMAGE FLOW — from code to Kubernetes Pod]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │                                                                    │
    │  anihpj/jobpost/views.py        (your Django code)                 │
    │         │                                                          │
    │         ▼ docker build -t anihpj/jobpost-api:v1 .                 │
    │  Docker Image: anihpj/jobpost-api:v1                               │
    │  Contents: Python 3.11 + Django + gunicorn + your app code        │
    │         │                                                          │
    │         ▼ docker push → Container Registry (Docker Hub / ECR)     │
    │  Registry: docker.io/anihpj/jobpost-api:v1                        │
    │         │                                                          │
    │         ▼ kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml                         │
    │  Kubernetes pulls image → creates Pod                              │
    │         │                                                          │
    │         ▼ Istio Mutating Webhook fires (namespace: istio-injection=enabled)
    │  Pod gets MODIFIED:                                                │
    │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
    │  │ Container 1: anihpj/jobpost-api:v1 (your code on port 8000)│  │
    │  │ Container 2: istio/proxyv2:1.22   (Envoy sidecar)          │  │
    │  │ InitContainer: istio-init         (sets iptables rules)     │  │
    │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
    │         │                                                          │
    │         ▼                                                          │
    │  Pod running: 2/2 containers READY                                │
    │  kubectl get pods -n anihpj → jobpost-api-xxx   2/2   Running    │
    │                                                                    │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [B.3 — Complete Deployment + Service YAML for all anihpj services]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  apiVersion: apps/v1                                               │
    │  kind: Deployment                                                  │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: jobpost-api                                               │
    │    namespace: anihpj                                               │
    │  spec:                                                             │
    │    replicas: 3                                                     │
    │    selector:                                                       │
    │      matchLabels:                                                  │
    │        app: jobpost-api                                            │
    │        version: v1                                                 │
    │    template:                                                       │
    │      metadata:                                                     │
    │        labels:                                                     │
    │          app: jobpost-api      ← REQUIRED for Kiali/Istio          │
    │          version: v1           ← REQUIRED for canary subsets       │
    │      spec:                                                         │
    │        containers:                                                 │
    │        - name: jobpost                                             │
    │          image: anihpj/jobpost-api:v1                              │
    │          ports:                                                    │
    │          - name: http          ← REQUIRED: Istio uses port name    │
    │            containerPort: 8000                                     │
    │          resources:                                                │
    │            requests:                                               │
    │              cpu: "100m"                                           │
    │              memory: "256Mi"                                       │
    │            limits:                                                 │
    │              cpu: "500m"                                           │
    │              memory: "512Mi"                                       │
    │          readinessProbe:                                           │
    │            httpGet:                                                │
    │              path: /health/                                        │
    │              port: 8000                                            │
    │  ---                                                               │
    │  apiVersion: v1                                                    │
    │  kind: Service                                                     │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: jobpost-api           ← VirtualService references this   │
    │    namespace: anihpj                                               │
    │  spec:                                                             │
    │    selector:                                                       │
    │      app: jobpost-api          ← matches Deployment label         │
    │    ports:                                                          │
    │    - name: http                ← REQUIRED: must be "http"         │
    │      port: 80                                                      │
    │      targetPort: 8000                                              │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [B.4 — Istio Gateway: anihpj.example.com (HTTP 80 + HTTPS 443)]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  # The Gateway opens ports on the ingress-gateway pods.            │
    │  # It only ACCEPTS traffic — a VirtualService (B.5) routes it.     │
    │  apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1                                │
    │  kind: Gateway                                                     │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: anihpj-gateway                                            │
    │    namespace: anihpj             ← any namespace works             │
    │  spec:                                                             │
    │    selector:                                                       │
    │      istio: ingressgateway       ← targets the gateway Deployment  │
    │    servers:                                                        │
    │    - port:                                                         │
    │        number: 80                                                  │
    │        name: http                                                  │
    │        protocol: HTTP                                              │
    │      hosts:                                                        │
    │      - "anihpj.example.com"                                        │
    │      tls:                                                          │
    │        httpsRedirect: true       ← 301 every HTTP call to HTTPS    │
    │    - port:                                                         │
    │        number: 443                                                 │
    │        name: https                                                 │
    │        protocol: HTTPS                                             │
    │      tls:                                                          │
    │        mode: SIMPLE              ← gateway terminates TLS          │
    │        credentialName: anihpj-tls-cert   ← K8s TLS secret name     │
    │      hosts:                                                        │
    │      - "anihpj.example.com"                                        │
    │  # The secret must live in the ingress-gateway POD's namespace:    │
    │  # kubectl create secret tls anihpj-tls-cert                       │
    │  #   --cert=fullchain.pem --key=privkey.pem -n istio-system        │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [B.5 — VirtualService: path-based routing for ALL anihpj services]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1                                │
    │  kind: VirtualService                                              │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: anihpj-routes                                             │
    │    namespace: anihpj                                               │
    │  spec:                                                             │
    │    hosts:                                                          │
    │    - "anihpj.example.com"        ← must match a Gateway host       │
    │    gateways:                                                       │
    │    - anihpj-gateway              ← binds this VS to B.4            │
    │    http:                         # FIRST MATCH WINS — order matters│
    │    - match:                                                        │
    │      - uri:                                                        │
    │          prefix: /jobs/                                            │
    │      route:                                                        │
    │      - destination:                                                │
    │          host: jobpost-api       ← K8s Service (:80 → pod :8000)   │
    │    - match:                                                        │
    │      - uri:                                                        │
    │          prefix: /users/                                           │
    │      route:                                                        │
    │      - destination:                                                │
    │          host: user-service      ← :8080                           │
    │    - match:                                                        │
    │      - uri:                                                        │
    │          prefix: /skills/                                          │
    │      route:                                                        │
    │      - destination:                                                │
    │          host: skills-service    ← :8090                           │
    │    - match:                                                        │
    │      - uri:                                                        │
    │          prefix: /locations/                                       │
    │      route:                                                        │
    │      - destination:                                                │
    │          host: location-service  ← :8070                           │
    │    - match:                                                        │
    │      - uri:                                                        │
    │          prefix: /auth/                                            │
    │      route:                                                        │
    │      - destination:                                                │
    │          host: auth-service                                        │
    │    - match:                                                        │
    │      - uri:                                                        │
    │          prefix: /search/                                          │
    │      route:                                                        │
    │      - destination:                                                │
    │          host: search-service                                      │
    │    - match:                                                        │
    │      - uri:                                                        │
    │          prefix: /notifications/                                   │
    │      route:                                                        │
    │      - destination:                                                │
    │          host: notification-service                                │
    │    - route:                      ← catch-all: NO match block, LAST │
    │      - destination:                                                │
    │          host: jobpost-api                                         │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [B.6 — VirtualService: canary 90/10 for jobpost-api]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1                                │
    │  kind: VirtualService                                              │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: jobpost-api-canary                                        │
    │    namespace: anihpj                                               │
    │  spec:                                                             │
    │    hosts:                                                          │
    │    - jobpost-api                 ← mesh-internal host (K8s Service)│
    │    http:                                                           │
    │    - route:                                                        │
    │      - destination:                                                │
    │          host: jobpost-api                                         │
    │          subset: v1              ← must exist in the DR (B.7)      │
    │        weight: 90                ← 90% stay on stable v1           │
    │      - destination:                                                │
    │          host: jobpost-api                                         │
    │          subset: v2                                                │
    │        weight: 10                ← 10% try v2; weights sum to 100  │
    │  # Ramp: 10 → 25 → 50 → 100 while watching Kiali/Grafana.          │
    │  # Instant rollback: set the v2 weight back to 0 and re-apply.     │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [B.7 — DestinationRule: subsets + LEAST_CONN + circuit breaker]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1                                │
    │  kind: DestinationRule                                             │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: jobpost-api-dr                                            │
    │    namespace: anihpj                                               │
    │  spec:                                                             │
    │    host: jobpost-api                                               │
    │    trafficPolicy:                                                  │
    │      loadBalancer:                                                 │
    │        simple: LEAST_REQUEST     ← route to the least-busy pod     │
    │      connectionPool:                                               │
    │        tcp:                                                        │
    │          maxConnections: 100     ← hard cap on TCP connections     │
    │        http:                                                       │
    │          http1MaxPendingRequests: 50   ← queue depth before 503    │
    │      outlierDetection:           ← the CIRCUIT BREAKER             │
    │        consecutiveGatewayErrors: 5     ← 5 straight 502/503/504    │
    │        interval: 30s             ← how often hosts are scanned     │
    │        baseEjectionTime: 30s     ← ejected 30s, doubles each trip  │
    │        maxEjectionPercent: 50    ← never eject more than half      │
    │      tls:                                                          │
    │        mode: ISTIO_MUTUAL        ← use Istio-issued mTLS certs     │
    │    subsets:                                                        │
    │    - name: v1                                                      │
    │      labels:                                                       │
    │        version: v1               ← selects pods with version=v1    │
    │    - name: v2                                                      │
    │      labels:                                                       │
    │        version: v2               ← the canary pods                 │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [B.8 — PeerAuthentication: STRICT mTLS namespace-wide]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1                                  │
    │  kind: PeerAuthentication                                          │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: default                 ← naming convention for ns-wide   │
    │    namespace: anihpj             ← applies to every workload here  │
    │  spec:                                                             │
    │    mtls:                                                           │
    │      mode: STRICT                ← mTLS only; plaintext gets a     │
    │                                    TCP connection RESET (not 403)  │
    │  # No selector: → namespace-wide. Add spec.selector.matchLabels    │
    │  # to scope one workload. Verify: istioctl x describe pod <pod>    │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [B.9 — AuthorizationPolicy: deny-all baseline (zero trust)]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1                                  │
    │  kind: AuthorizationPolicy                                         │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: deny-all                                                  │
    │    namespace: anihpj                                               │
    │  spec: {}                        ← empty spec = DENY EVERYTHING    │
    │  # Why it works: an ALLOW policy with no rules matches nothing,    │
    │  # and once ANY policy selects a workload, all traffic that no     │
    │  # ALLOW rule matches is denied.                                   │
    │  # Callers now see: HTTP 403 "RBAC: access denied".                │
    │  # Apply this FIRST, then open pairs one by one (B.10).            │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [B.10 — AuthorizationPolicy: allow rules per service pair]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  # Pair 1: ingress gateway → jobpost-api (GET/POST only)           │
    │  apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1                                  │
    │  kind: AuthorizationPolicy                                         │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: allow-ingress-to-jobpost                                  │
    │    namespace: anihpj                                               │
    │  spec:                                                             │
    │    selector:                                                       │
    │      matchLabels:                                                  │
    │        app: jobpost-api          ← policy attaches to the SERVER   │
    │    action: ALLOW                                                   │
    │    rules:                                                          │
    │    - from:                                                         │
    │      - source:                                                     │
    │          principals:             ← SPIFFE identity of the CALLER   │
    │          - "cluster.local/ns/istio-system/sa/istio-ingressgateway" │
    │      to:                                                           │
    │      - operation:                                                  │
    │          methods: ["GET", "POST"]                                  │
    │  ---                                                               │
    │  # Pair 2: jobpost-api → user-service (GET on /api/users/* only)   │
    │  apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1                                  │
    │  kind: AuthorizationPolicy                                         │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: allow-jobpost-to-users                                    │
    │    namespace: anihpj                                               │
    │  spec:                                                             │
    │    selector:                                                       │
    │      matchLabels:                                                  │
    │        app: user-service                                           │
    │    action: ALLOW                                                   │
    │    rules:                                                          │
    │    - from:                                                         │
    │      - source:                                                     │
    │          principals:                                               │
    │          - "cluster.local/ns/anihpj/sa/jobpost-api"                │
    │      to:                                                           │
    │      - operation:                                                  │
    │          methods: ["GET"]                                          │
    │          paths: ["/api/users/*"]                                   │
    │  # Every OTHER pair stays 403-denied by B.9's deny-all.            │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [B.11 — ServiceEntry: external payment API (api.stripe.com)]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1                                │
    │  kind: ServiceEntry                                                │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: stripe-payments                                           │
    │    namespace: anihpj                                               │
    │  spec:                                                             │
    │    hosts:                                                          │
    │    - api.stripe.com              ← the DNS name the app calls      │
    │    ports:                                                          │
    │    - number: 443                                                   │
    │      name: https                                                   │
    │      protocol: HTTPS                                               │
    │    location: MESH_EXTERNAL       ← lives outside; no sidecar there │
    │    resolution: DNS               ← resolve the name at call time   │
    │  # Required when outboundTrafficPolicy.mode = REGISTRY_ONLY —      │
    │  # without it, payment calls die with 502. Bonus: Stripe traffic   │
    │  # now shows up in Kiali/Grafana like any mesh service.            │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [B.12 — RequestAuthentication: JWT validation for API endpoints]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1                                  │
    │  kind: RequestAuthentication                                       │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: jwt-auth                                                  │
    │    namespace: anihpj                                               │
    │  spec:                                                             │
    │    selector:                                                       │
    │      matchLabels:                                                  │
    │        app: jobpost-api          ← check JWTs arriving here        │
    │    jwtRules:                                                       │
    │    - issuer: "auth.anihpj.example.com"   ← must equal token "iss"  │
    │      jwksUri: "http://auth-service:8080/.well-known/jwks.json"     │
    │      forwardOriginalToken: true  ← Django still sees the JWT       │
    │  ---                                                               │
    │  # GOTCHA: RequestAuthentication alone only rejects INVALID        │
    │  # tokens (401). Requests with NO token still pass! Enforce        │
    │  # token presence with an AuthorizationPolicy:                     │
    │  apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1                                  │
    │  kind: AuthorizationPolicy                                         │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: require-jwt                                               │
    │    namespace: anihpj                                               │
    │  spec:                                                             │
    │    selector:                                                       │
    │      matchLabels:                                                  │
    │        app: jobpost-api                                            │
    │    action: ALLOW                                                   │
    │    rules:                                                          │
    │    - from:                                                         │
    │      - source:                                                     │
    │          requestPrincipals: ["*"]    ← any VALIDATED issuer/sub    │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [B.13 — Telemetry: 1% sampling + custom metric label]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  apiVersion: telemetry.istio.io/v1                                 │
    │  kind: Telemetry                                                   │
    │  metadata:                                                         │
    │    name: anihpj-telemetry                                          │
    │    namespace: anihpj             ← ns scope (istio-system = mesh)  │
    │  spec:                                                             │
    │    tracing:                                                        │
    │    - randomSamplingPercentage: 1.0   ← trace 1 in 100 requests     │
    │    metrics:                                                        │
    │    - providers:                                                    │
    │      - name: prometheus                                            │
    │      overrides:                                                    │
    │      - match:                                                      │
    │          metric: REQUEST_COUNT   ← istio_requests_total            │
    │        tagOverrides:                                               │
    │          job_category:           ← add a NEW label to the metric   │
    │            value: request.headers["x-job-category"]                │
    │  # 1% sampling keeps overhead tiny at anihpj's 847 req/s while     │
    │  # still catching slow paths like skills-service's 1240ms p99.     │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [APPLY ORDER — how the B.1-B.13 manifests fit together]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  B.1 namespace → B.2 images → B.3 deploy+svc     (app up, 2/2)     │
    │       │                                                            │
    │       ▼  traffic layer                                             │
    │  B.4 Gateway → B.5 routes → B.7 DR subsets → B.6 canary 90/10      │
    │                  (apply the DR BEFORE the canary VS — a VS         │
    │                   that names a missing subset returns 503)         │
    │       │                                                            │
    │       ▼  security layer                                            │
    │  B.8 STRICT mTLS → B.9 deny-all → B.10 allow pairs → B.12 JWT      │
    │       │                                                            │
    │       ▼  egress + observability                                    │
    │  B.11 ServiceEntry (Stripe) → B.13 Telemetry (1% sampling)         │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


Appendix C: istioctl Command Reference
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    [WHY THIS APPENDIX EXISTS] Every istioctl command used anywhere in this
    guide, grouped by the TASK you're doing (installing, debugging, viewing
    a dashboard) rather than alphabetically — reach for this mid-task, when
    you know WHAT you're trying to do but not the exact subcommand spelling.

    [TABLE organized by task category]

    INSTALLATION:
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  istioctl install --set profile=demo -y                │
    │  istioctl install -f custom-iop.yaml                   │
    │  istioctl upgrade                                      │
    │  istioctl uninstall --purge                            │
    │  istioctl verify-install                               │
    │  istioctl x precheck                                   │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    DEBUGGING:
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  istioctl proxy-status                                  │
    │  istioctl proxy-config cluster <pod> -n <ns>           │
    │  istioctl proxy-config route <pod> -n <ns>             │
    │  istioctl proxy-config listener <pod> -n <ns>          │
    │  istioctl proxy-config endpoint <pod> -n <ns>          │
    │  istioctl analyze -n <ns>                              │
    │  istioctl analyze --all-namespaces                     │
    │  istioctl x describe pod <pod> -n <ns>                 │
    │  istioctl bug-report                                   │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

         - ⚠️ Old tutorials still mention
           "istioctl authn tls-check" — that command was REMOVED from
           istioctl years ago and NO LONGER EXISTS on a current cluster.
           Learn the modern replacements below, or you will burn exam
           minutes on "unknown command" errors.

    [REMOVED/RENAMED COMMANDS — do not use on the exam]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  GONE:  istioctl authn tls-check <pod> -n <ns>       (removed)     │
    │    use → istioctl x describe pod <pod> -n <ns>  effective mTLS     │
    │    use → istioctl proxy-config secret <pod> -n <ns>  live certs    │
    │    or  → Kiali graph lock icons / openssl s_client to pod port     │
    │                                                                    │
    │  GONE:  istioctl register / deregister               (removed)     │
    │    use → WorkloadEntry + WorkloadGroup CRDs for VM workloads       │
    │                                                                    │
    │  MOVED: istioctl experimental <cmd>  =  istioctl x <cmd>           │
    │    "x" is the alias; some x commands graduate to top level         │
    │                                                                    │
    │  RISKY: istioctl upgrade (in-place) — exists, but prefer the       │
    │    canary upgrade: install a new revision, relabel namespaces      │
    │    with istio.io/rev, restart workloads, uninstall old rev         │
    │                                                                    │
    │  BROKEN: istioctl verify-install                     (deprecated)  │
    │    use → istioctl x precheck  (pre-install requirements check)     │
    │    use → istioctl analyze -n <ns>  (post-install config check)     │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    DASHBOARDS:
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  istioctl dashboard kiali                              │
    │  istioctl dashboard grafana                            │
    │  istioctl dashboard jaeger                             │
    │  istioctl dashboard prometheus                         │
    │  istioctl dashboard zipkin                             │
    │  istioctl dashboard controlz                           │
    │  istioctl dashboard envoy <pod> -n <ns>                │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    REVISION TAGGING (canary promotion):
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  istioctl tag set prod-stable --revision 1-30-2        │
    │  istioctl tag list                                     │
    │  istioctl tag remove prod-canary                       │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    AMBIENT MODE (WAYPOINTS):
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  istioctl waypoint apply -n anihpj --enroll-namespace  │
    │  istioctl waypoint list -n anihpj                      │
    │  istioctl waypoint status -n anihpj <name>             │
    │  istioctl waypoint delete --all -n anihpj              │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


Appendix D: Common Istio Errors and Solutions
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    [WHY THIS APPENDIX EXISTS] Something in anihpj just broke. This is the
    triage table: symptom in, likely cause and fix out — reach for this
    BEFORE re-reading a whole chapter, then go back to the chapter that
    covers the matching CRD or component only if you need the underlying
    "why."

    [TABLE: Error → Cause → Diagnostic Command → Fix]

    | Error / Symptom                   | Likely Cause                        | Fix                                       |
    | ───────────────────────────────── | ─────────────────────────────────── | ───────────────────────────────────────── |
    | Pod shows 1/1 not 2/2 containers  | Sidecar not injected                | Label namespace: istio-injection=enabled  |
    | 503 RBAC: access denied           | AuthorizationPolicy blocking        | Add explicit ALLOW policy                 |
    | 503 upstream connect error        | DestinationRule mTLS mode wrong     | Match PeerAuthentication mode             |
    | VirtualService not routing        | Subset not in DestinationRule       | Add matching subset to DR                 |
    | Traffic still going to all pods   | Missing version: label on pods      | Add version label to Deployment           |
    | istioctl analyze: "host not found"| Service name mismatch in VS         | Match VS host to exact K8s svc name       |
    | High latency after Istio install  | Tracing 100% sampling overhead      | Set sampling to 1% in Telemetry           |
    | Circuit breaker tripping often    | outlierDetection too aggressive     | Increase consecutiveGatewayErrors         |
    | External API calls failing        | Mesh in REGISTRY_ONLY mode          | Add ServiceEntry for external host        |
    | PROXY_STATUS shows STALE          | Network issue to istiod             | Check istiod pod health                   |
    | Apply fails: webhook x509 error   | istiod webhook cert/CA not ready    | Check istiod up; svc 443→15017 reachable  |
    | EDS: endpoints list is empty      | Svc selector ≠ pod labels; not Ready| Fix Service selector / readinessProbe     |
    | 401 from RequestAuthentication    | issuer/jwksUri mismatch or bad token| Match issuer + jwksUri to the token iss   |
    | Locality failover not working     | No outlierDetection in DR (required)| Add outlierDetection to enable failover   |
    | Ambient pod shows 1/1 "no sidecar"| By design — ambient mode has none   | Normal: ztunnel proxies node traffic      |
    | Sidecar missing after ns labeled  | Namespace label key/value typo      | kubectl get ns --show-labels; fix key     |
    | Connection reset by peer (no 503) | mTLS PERMISSIVE/STRICT mismatch     | Align PeerAuthentication + DR tls mode    |
    | All calls denied post AuthzPolicy | 1st ALLOW policy = deny-all rest    | Add ALLOW rule for every legit caller     |

    [FIRST-RESPONSE DIAGNOSTIC LADDER — run these in this order]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  1. istioctl analyze -n anihpj            config errors?           │
    │  2. istioctl proxy-status                 SYNCED or STALE?         │
    │  3. kubectl get pods -n anihpj            2/2 READY?               │
    │  4. istioctl x describe pod <pod>         which policies apply?    │
    │  5. istioctl proxy-config endpoint <pod>  endpoints exist?         │
    │  6. kubectl logs <pod> -c istio-proxy     Envoy access-log codes   │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [ENVOY RESPONSE-FLAG DECODER — the code after the status in the access log]
    ┌──────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┐
    │ Flag │ Meaning                                       │ Check this first                  │
    ├──────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────┤
    │ UH   │ No healthy upstream hosts (0 Ready endpoints) │ readinessProbe; pc endpoint <pod> │
    │ UC   │ Upstream conn. terminated (reset) — not UH!   │ mTLS mode mismatch / app crash    │
    │ UO   │ Upstream overflow — circuit breaker tripped   │ outlierDetection / connectionPool │
    │ NR   │ No route configured for the request           │ VirtualService host + route match │
    │ DC   │ Downstream conn. terminated by the client     │ client / LB idle timeout          │
    └──────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────┘

Appendix E: Istio Terminology Glossary
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    [WHY THIS APPENDIX EXISTS] Every chapter defines its terms the first
    time they appear (📖 DEFINITION boxes) — this appendix is the single
    landing page for all of them, roughly alphabetized, for the moment a
    term resurfaces three chapters later and you want the definition
    without hunting for where it first appeared.

    [GLOSSARY TABLE: 40+ terms alphabetically sorted]

    | Term                   | Definition                                                 |
    | ────────────────────── | ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── |
    | ADS                    | Aggregated Discovery Service — one ordered xDS stream      |
    | Ambient Mesh           | Sidecar-free Istio mode using ztunnel + waypoint proxies   |
    | AuthorizationPolicy    | Istio CRD for access control (who can call what)           |
    | Canary Upgrade         | Run old + new istiod side by side; move ns via revision    |
    | Circuit Breaker        | Pattern: stop calls to a failing service automatically     |
    | Citadel                | istiod's built-in CA — signs and rotates workload certs    |
    | Control Plane          | istiod — distributes config, certs, policy to proxies      |
    | CRD                    | Custom Resource Definition — extending Kubernetes API      |
    | Data Plane             | Envoy sidecars, or ztunnel proxies in ambient mode         |
    | Delta xDS              | xDS mode sending only changed resources; default since 1.22|
    | DestinationRule        | Policies for traffic going TO a service (LB, mTLS, CB)     |
    | Dry-run                | Annotation istio.io/dry-run — test policy w/o enforcing    |
    | East-West Gateway      | Gateway for cross-cluster traffic in multi-cluster mesh    |
    | Egress Gateway         | Dedicated exit proxy — force outbound through one point    |
    | Envoy                  | High-performance L7 proxy; Istio's sidecar proxy           |
    | exportTo               | Field scoping which namespaces can see a VS/DR/SE          |
    | extensionProvider      | MeshConfig entry naming a tracing/logging/authz backend    |
    | Fault Injection        | Deliberately inject delays or errors to test resilience    |
    | Gateway (Istio)        | Entry/exit point to the mesh for external traffic          |
    | HBONE                  | HTTP-Based Overlay Network Environment — ambient tunnel    |
    | istiod                 | Istio control plane: Pilot + Citadel + Galley in one pod   |
    | istioctl               | Istio command-line tool (like kubectl for Istio)           |
    | IstioOperator          | Install-time API: profiles + component overrides (IOP)     |
    | Jaeger                 | Distributed tracing backend; visualizes trace spans        |
    | Kiali                  | Istio mesh visualization and management console            |
    | Locality Load Balancing| Prefer same-zone pods; failover needs outlierDetection     |
    | mTLS                   | Mutual TLS — both parties verify certificates              |
    | Mutating Webhook       | K8s admission hook istiod uses to inject the sidecar       |
    | Outlier Detection      | DestinationRule setting that implements circuit breaking   |
    | PeerAuthentication     | Istio CRD configuring mTLS mode per namespace/workload     |
    | Pilot                  | istiod component: reads CRDs, configures Envoy via xDS     |
    | RED Metrics            | Rate, Errors, Duration — the three key service metrics     |
    | RequestAuthentication  | Istio CRD for JWT token validation at mesh level           |
    | Revision               | Named istiod install (e.g. 1-22) targeted by istio.io/rev  |
    | Secure Naming          | Maps service identity → service name; stops impersonation  |
    | Service Mesh           | Infrastructure layer for service-to-service communication  |
    | ServiceEntry           | Istio CRD to register external services in the mesh        |
    | Sidecar (container)    | Envoy proxy container injected alongside your app          |
    | Sidecar (resource)     | Istio CRD to configure sidecar proxy scope                 |
    | SPIFFE                 | Secure Production Identity Framework — cert standard used  |
    | SVID                   | SPIFFE Verifiable Identity Document — workload certificate |
    | Telemetry              | Istio CRD for configuring metrics, tracing, logging        |
    | Trust Domain           | Identity root of a mesh (default cluster.local)            |
    | VirtualService         | Istio CRD defining routing rules for a service             |
    | WasmPlugin             | CRD (extensions.istio.io) — run Wasm modules in the proxy  |
    | Waypoint Proxy         | Ambient mesh L7 proxy per namespace (no sidecar needed)    |
    | xDS API                | Protocol used by istiod to configure Envoy proxies         |
    | ztunnel                | Ambient mesh L4 proxy; handles mTLS without sidecars       |


Appendix F: Istio Learning Path Recommendations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    [WHY THIS APPENDIX EXISTS] Section 7 gave you the 3-arc map of the whole
    guide; this appendix turns that map into a literal calendar — an 8-week
    pace, a skills checklist per week, and a hands-on lab list — for anyone
    who wants a schedule to hold themselves to, not just a reading order.

    [LEARNING PATH VISUAL — 8-week progressive mastery]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │                                                                        │
    │  WEEK  1  [██░░░░░░░░░░░░░░]  12%  FOUNDATIONS: The Problem           │
    │  WEEK  2  [████░░░░░░░░░░░░]  25%  FOUNDATIONS: Istio + Architecture  │
    │  WEEK  3  [██████░░░░░░░░░░]  37%  TRAFFIC: Install + Gateway/VS      │
    │  WEEK  4  [████████░░░░░░░░]  50%  TRAFFIC: DR + ServiceEntry + Canary│
    │  WEEK  5  [██████████░░░░░░]  62%  OBSERVE: Prometheus/Grafana/Jaeger │

Appendix G: Local Development Quick Start (Minikube + Istio + anihpj)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    [WHY THIS APPENDIX EXISTS] Every hands-on drill in this guide assumes a
    live anihpj mesh already exists somewhere. This appendix is that
    somewhere — the exact command sequence from an empty minikube VM to a
    running, sidecar-injected anihpj, so no chapter's drill ever blocks on
    "but how do I even get a cluster."

    [COMPLETE LOCAL SETUP — from zero to Istio mesh in 10 commands]

    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  # 1. Start minikube with enough resources for Istio + anihpj          │
    │  minikube start --cpus=4 --memory=16384 --disk-size=40g                │
    │                                                                        │
    │  # 2. Install Istio (demo profile = all tools included)               │
    │  curl -L https://istio.io/downloadIstio | sh -                         │
    │  cd istio-1.22.*                                                       │
    │  export PATH=$PWD/bin:$PATH                                            │
    │  istioctl install --set profile=demo -y                                │
    │                                                                        │
    │  # 3. Verify installation                                              │
    │  kubectl get pods -n istio-system                                      │
    │  # Expected: istiod, istio-ingressgateway, istio-egressgateway         │
    │  #           — Running (demo profile installs ONLY these 3)            │
    │  # kiali/grafana/prometheus/jaeger are NOT included — see 3b           │
    │                                                                        │
    │  # 3b. Install observability addons (NOT included in demo profile)     │
    │  kubectl apply -f samples/addons/prometheus.yaml                       │
    │  kubectl apply -f samples/addons/grafana.yaml                          │
    │  kubectl apply -f samples/addons/jaeger.yaml                           │
    │  kubectl apply -f samples/addons/kiali.yaml                            │
    │  kubectl rollout status deployment/kiali -n istio-system               │
    │                                                                        │
    │  # 4. Create anihpj namespace with Istio injection                     │
    │  kubectl create namespace anihpj                                       │
    │  kubectl label namespace anihpj istio-injection=enabled                │
    │                                                                        │
    │  # 5. Build Docker images (see Appendix B.2 for Dockerfiles)          │
    │  docker build -t anihpj/jobpost-api:v1 ./anihpj/jobpost/              │
    │  docker build -t anihpj/user-service:v1 ./anihpj/user-service/        │
    │  # ... repeat for all services                                        │
    │                                                                        │
    │  # 6. Load images into minikube (skip if using remote registry)       │
    │  minikube image load anihpj/jobpost-api:v1                             │
    │  minikube image load anihpj/user-service:v1                            │
    │                                                                        │
    │  # 7. Deploy anihpj services (see Appendix B.3 for YAML)              │
    │  kubectl apply -f anihpj/k8s/ -n anihpj                                │
    │                                                                        │
    │  # 8. Verify pods have sidecars (2/2 containers)                      │
    │  kubectl get pods -n anihpj                                            │
    │  # Expected: jobpost-api-xxx  2/2  Running                             │
    │                                                                        │
    │  # 9. Verify Istio sync status                                        │
    │  istioctl proxy-status                                                 │
    │  # Expected: ALL pods show SYNCED                                      │
    │                                                                        │
    │  # 10. Open dashboards                                                │
    │  istioctl dashboard kiali      # Service topology graph               │
    │  istioctl dashboard grafana    # RED metrics dashboards               │
    │  istioctl dashboard jaeger     # Distributed traces                   │
    │                                                                        │
    │  # BONUS: Generate some traffic to see in dashboards                  │
    │  kubectl port-forward svc/istio-ingressgateway -n istio-system 8080:80 │
    │  for i in {1..100}; do curl http://localhost:8080/jobs/; done         │
    │  # Now refresh Kiali — you'll see live traffic!                       │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [LOCAL DEV WORKFLOW — daily routine for anihpj development with Istio]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  1.  kubectl get pods -n anihpj           # All 2/2?                  │
    │  2.  istioctl proxy-status                 # All SYNCED?               │
    │  3.  istioctl dashboard kiali              # Open topology             │
    │  4.  kubectl apply -f canary-vs.yaml       # Deploy canary            │
    │  5.  watch Kiali as traffic splits         # Monitor live              │
    │  6.  istioctl dashboard grafana            # Check RED metrics         │
    │  7.  istioctl analyze -n anihpj            # Validate config           │
    │  8.  kubectl logs deploy/jobpost-api -c istio-proxy  # Debug proxy    │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

         - Minikube is the quickest personal Istio lab, but it has sharp
           edges that cost newcomers hours — the five traps below explain
           almost every "Istio is broken on my laptop" report
         - DEFINITION: minikube tunnel is a helper process that routes real
           traffic from your host into LoadBalancer Services, so the
           istio-ingressgateway gets an EXTERNAL-IP instead of <pending>

    [MINIKUBE GOTCHAS — the five traps that break local Istio labs]
    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  GOTCHA 1: MEMORY TOO LOW → istiod stuck in Pending                    │
    │    Symptom: kubectl get pods -n istio-system → istiod 0/1 Pending      │
    │    Cause:   minikube's default 2GB VM cannot fit istiod + addons       │
    │    Fix:     minikube delete, then restart with more resources:         │
    │             minikube start --cpus=4 --memory=16384                     │
    ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │  GOTCHA 2: ErrImagePull FOR anihpj/jobpost-api:v1                      │
    │    minikube's Docker daemon is NOT your host's — pick ONE fix:         │
    │    a) eval $(minikube docker-env)    # build INSIDE minikube's Docker  │
    │       docker build -t anihpj/jobpost-api:v1 .                          │
    │    b) minikube image load anihpj/jobpost-api:v1   # copy from host     │
    │    Either way set imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent (Always forces pull)   │
    ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │  GOTCHA 3: EXTERNAL-IP STUCK <pending> ON istio-ingressgateway         │
    │    minikube has no cloud LoadBalancer — open a second terminal:        │
    │    minikube tunnel           # keeps running; asks for sudo/admin      │
    │    kubectl get svc istio-ingressgateway -n istio-system                │
    │    → EXTERNAL-IP now shows a real address you can curl                 │
    ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │  GOTCHA 4: TUNNEL PROCESS ANNOYING? USE METALLB INSTEAD                │
    │    minikube addons enable metallb                                      │
    │    minikube addons configure metallb   # then give a small IP range    │
    │    e.g. 192.168.49.100-192.168.49.110 (inside the minikube ip subnet)  │
    │    → LoadBalancer Services get stable IPs, no tunnel process needed    │
    ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │  GOTCHA 5: PODS STUCK PENDING UNDER RESTRICTED PSA/PSS                 │
    │    Symptom: istio-init container denied — NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW            │
    │    Cause:   namespace has restricted Pod Security Admission (PSA)      │
    │    Fix:     use the Istio CNI plugin instead of init-container         │
    │             injection (no NET_ADMIN needed in the app namespace):      │
    │    istioctl install --set profile=demo \                               │
    │      --set components.cni.enabled=true -y                              │
    │    → CNI plugin runs iptables setup at node level — no per-pod         │
    │      NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW required, so PSA restricted mode is fine        │
    └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


Appendix H: Istio Quick-Reference Cheat Sheet
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    [WHY THIS APPENDIX EXISTS] A small set of printable cards distilling
    the entire guide — every other appendix is a deep table you search;
    these are small enough to keep open in a side window (or print) for
    exam morning or a live incident, when you need the single most common
    command in each category, not the full reference.

    [ONE-PAGE VISUAL CHEAT SHEET — print-ready reference card]

    ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  ISTIO QUICK-REFERENCE CARD                                            │
    ├──────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │  INSTALL                 │  NAMESPACE SETUP                            │
    │  istioctl install        │  kubectl create ns anihpj                   │
    │    --set profile=demo    │  kubectl label ns anihpj                    │
    │                          │    istio-injection=enabled                  │
    ├──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │  CHECK STATUS            │  DIAGNOSE PROBLEMS                          │
    │  istioctl proxy-status   │  istioctl analyze -n anihpj                 │
    │  kubectl get pods -n     │  istioctl x describe pod \                  │
    │    istio-system          │    <pod> -n anihpj                          │
    │  kubectl get pods 2/2    │  istioctl proxy-config route \              │
    │    -n anihpj             │    <pod> -n anihpj                          │
    ├──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │  TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT CRDs │  SECURITY CRDs                              │
    │  Gateway — mesh entry    │  PeerAuthentication — mTLS mode             │
    │  VirtualService — routes │  AuthorizationPolicy — who can call         │
    │  DestinationRule — policy│  RequestAuthentication — JWT verify         │
    │  ServiceEntry — external │                                             │
    ├──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │  OPEN DASHBOARDS         │  KEY CONCEPTS                               │
    │  istioctl dashboard kiali│  Sidecar = Envoy next to your app           │
    │  istioctl dashboard      │  Data Plane = all sidecars                  │
    │    grafana               │  Control Plane = istiod                     │
    │  istioctl dashboard      │  xDS = how istiod → Envoy                   │
    │    jaeger                │  iptables = traffic interception            │
    ├──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │  mTLS MODES              │  CANARY PATTERN                             │
    │  PERMISSIVE — allow both │  1. Deploy v2 (replicas: 2)                 │
    │  STRICT — mTLS only      │  2. VS weight: v1=90%, v2=10%               │
    │  DISABLE — no TLS        │  3. Monitor Kiali / Grafana                 │
    │                          │  4. Gradually: 10→25→50→100%               │
    │  Apply: PeerAuth CRD     │  Rollback: set v2=0% instantly             │
    ├──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │  CIRCUIT BREAKER         │  RED METRICS (auto from Envoy)              │
    │  outlierDetection:       │  R = Rate (req/s)                           │
    │   consecutive5xxErrors: 5│  E = Errors (% 4xx/5xx)                     │
    │    interval: 30s         │  D = Duration (latency p50/p95/p99)         │
    │    baseEjectionTime: 30s │  No code change needed!                     │
    └──────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [DEPRECATED COMMAND WATCH — removed istioctl tools & modern equivalents]
    ┌──────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────┐

    [ISTIO CRD SELECTION GUIDE — which resource solves which problem]
    ┌──────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  I want to...                    │  Use this Istio resource           │
    ├──────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────┤
    │  Accept external HTTPS traffic   │  Gateway                           │
    │  Route by URL path               │  VirtualService (http.match.uri)   │
    │  Do a canary deployment          │  VirtualService (weight) +         │
    │                                  │  DestinationRule (subsets)         │
    │  Add retry logic                 │  VirtualService (retries)          │
    │  Add timeout                     │  VirtualService (timeout)          │
    │  Inject faults for testing       │  VirtualService (fault)            │
    │  Load balance requests           │  DestinationRule (loadBalancer)    │
    │  Add circuit breaker             │  DestinationRule (outlierDetection)│
    │  Encrypt service-to-service      │  PeerAuthentication (STRICT)       │
    │  Block a service from calling    │  AuthorizationPolicy (DENY)        │
    │  Validate JWT tokens             │  RequestAuthentication             │
    │  Call an external API            │  ServiceEntry                      │
    │  Audit all egress traffic        │  ServiceEntry + EgressGateway      │
    │  See service topology            │  Kiali dashboard                   │
    │  See request traces              │  Jaeger (istioctl dashboard jaeger)│
    │  See latency / error metrics     │  Grafana Istio dashboards          │
    │  Stop cascade failures           │  DestinationRule (outlierDetection)│
    │  Test resilience                 │  VirtualService (fault)            │
    │  Control resource usage          │  Sidecar (resource) + EnvoyFilter  │
    │  Add non-K8s workloads to mesh   │  WorkloadEntry                     │
    │  Run the mesh with no sidecars   │  Ambient mode: label namespace     │
    │  (ztunnel handles L4 + mTLS)     │  istio.io/dataplane-mode=ambient   │
    │  Add L7 policy in ambient mode   │  Waypoint proxy per namespace      │
    │                                  │  (istioctl waypoint apply -n ns)   │
    │  Extend Envoy with custom code   │  WasmPlugin                        │
    │                                  │  (extensions.istio.io/v1alpha1)    │
    └──────────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────┘

    [KEY DEFAULT PORTS — same on every sidecar / istiod pod]
    ┌───────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │ Port  │ Purpose                                            │
    ├───────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤

    │ 15020 │ Merged Prometheus telemetry (agent+Envoy+app)      │

    │ 15090 │ Envoy Prometheus stats (/stats/prometheus)         │
    └───────┴────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    [KEY ANNOTATIONS & LABELS — per-pod / per-namespace overrides]
    ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │ Annotation / label                      │ Purpose                                             │
    ├─────────────────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │ sidecar.istio.io/inject                 │ Per-pod override: inject ("true") or skip ("false") │

Appendix I: Full-Length ICA Mock Exam — 2-Hour Simulation
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    [HOW TO USE THIS APPENDIX — READ BEFORE YOU START THE CLOCK]
    - The REAL ICA exam is 2 hours, hands-on and performance-based — you
      work inside a LIVE Istio cluster typing real kubectl/istioctl
      commands and YAML, not answering multiple-choice questions. The
      official istio.io documentation is allowed open in another tab, so
      every task below is phrased the way the real exam phrases work:
      "configure this, verify it works" — not "which of the following..."
    - These are 25 FRESH scenarios built for this simulation — they reuse
      anihpj's services and the same commands taught throughout the
      guide, but they are NOT copies of the per-chapter Q&A blocks. Do
      not expect to recognize the exact wording from earlier chapters.
    - Timed self-practice rules:
      • Budget ~4-5 minutes per task (25 tasks ≈ 105-125 minutes,
        leaving 15-35 minutes to flag-review at the end — the same math
        the real exam rewards)
      • If you're stuck past 5 minutes: FLAG it, move on, come back with
        fresh eyes — this is mistake #2 from the Top 10 Mistakes panel
        near the front of this guide, and it costs candidates the most
      • Always verify after every change (kubectl get/describe,
        istioctl proxy-status, or a real curl) — an applied YAML that
        was never verified is an unfinished task on the real exam
      • Set your working namespace once and stop typing -n anihpj:
        kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=anihpj
    - Domain weighting below matches the OFFICIAL Linux Foundation ICA
      blueprint exactly (see the ICA EXAM OVERVIEW panel at the front of
      this guide) — NOT an even split across the 4 domains:

    ┌────────────────────────────────┬────────────┬────────────┐
    │ DOMAIN                         │ WEIGHT     │ TASKS      │
    ├────────────────────────────────┼────────────┼────────────┤
